details.effect: Once on each of your turns, when a Puppet is put onto your field, put 2 Puppet tokens into your EX area. [act] [cost04]: Give this follower [attack]+2/[defense]+2. Summon a Puppet token.

issues: Remove the incorrect 'fanfare' keyword; the source text does not include Fanfare.

The trigger ability should put 2 Puppet tokens into your EX area when a Puppet is put onto your field, but the trigger filter is placed at the ability root instead of inside a supported condition/effect structure. Re-encode this using a valid onAllyFollowerEnter implementation that restricts the entering follower to identityName 'Puppet' while keeping oncePerTurn true.

details.effect: As an additional cost to play this card, engage 2 cards named Naterran Great Tree on your field. ---------- Select an enemy follower on the field and up to 1 Natura follower on your field. Deal 5 damage to the first follower and 2 damage to its leader. Give the second [attack]+1/[defense]+1.

issues: The additional cost is wrong: it must engage exactly 2 cards named Naterran Great Tree on your field, not any 2 ally field cards. Re-encode the engage targets to restrict to identityName 'Naterran Great Tree'.
The damage effect uses an invalid operation name. Replace dealDamageFollowerAndLeader with the implemented op damageFollowerAndLeader.
The damage effect is incomplete because it does not target 'an enemy follower on the field.' Re-encode the damage step so it selects 1 enemy follower and deals it 5 damage and 2 damage to its leader.

The buff effect targets the wrong set of cards. It should target up to 1 Natura follower on your field, not any selfFollower. Re-encode the buff targets to your field with a Natura trait filter and make the selection optional.

details.effect: Storm. On Evolve: Combo (3) - Give this follower [attack]+1/[defense]+1. Combo (5) - Give [attack]+3/[defense]+3 instead.

issues: The Combo thresholds are encoded in the wrong order. Combo (5) should take precedence and give this follower +3/+3 instead of the Combo (3) bonus; re-encode as if combo 5 then buff +3/+3, else if combo 3 then buff +1/+1.
